description: Change one of the inbox's own meetings (role "organizer"): title, time, attendees, description, location or join link. Everyone on the list gets the new version; attendees taken off the list get a cancellation; a new time or place asks everyone to answer again. Fields you leave out keep their value; attendees replaces the whole list; null clears description, location or conference_url. Only when the user asks. Fails with calendar_not_organizer for an invite the inbox received (answer those with respond_to_invite) and calendar_event_changed if another change landed first (read it again with get_event). With draft: true the change waits for a person to approve it (the draft's calendar.removed_attendees lists who it takes off). Needs calendar:write and messages:send; with draft: true, drafts:write instead (a key that may write drafts but not send must pass draft: true). If a call answers calendar_not_enabled, Meetings is turned off for this workspace or server: tell the user.

attendees.description: The new attendee list (replaces it; people taken off get a cancellation).

email.description: Email address of the person to invite.

name.description: Their name, shown in the invite.

conference_url.description: New video meeting link (https); null clears it.

draft.description: true: save it as a draft for a person to approve instead of sending it. Nothing goes out, and the meeting changes only when someone sends the draft. Needs drafts:write instead of messages:send. Use it when the user wants to check first, or when this key may not send.

duration_minutes.description: New length in minutes (keeps the start unless you give one).

end.description: New end: ISO 8601 with an offset ("2026-11-10T15:00:00Z"), or a date ("2026-11-10") for an all-day meeting.

event_id.description: Event id (from list_events, or the calendar.event_id of a message).

message.description: A short note above the meeting details in the email.

start.description: New start: ISO 8601 with an offset ("2026-11-10T15:00:00Z"), or a date ("2026-11-10") for an all-day meeting.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the email words the time in, e.g. "Europe/Paris". A series is sent in it, so it keeps its local time when the clocks change; calendars show each meeting in their own zone.

name: update_meeting
title: Change meeting
